name: Sump Ghost
summary: Sump Ghost; You gain expertise in Stealth when in urban ruins, sewers, vents, tunnels, or industrial terrain.  Sump Ghost; You may hide when lightly obscured by smoke, steam, crowds, or machinery.  Sump Ghost; Once per short rest, become hidden from one creature even if it can see you, provided there is cover, smoke, steam, machinery, darkness, or a crowd within 10 ft.
descriptionMarkdown:
Sump Ghost; You gain expertise in Stealth when in urban ruins, sewers, vents, tunnels, or industrial terrain.

Sump Ghost; You may hide when lightly obscured by smoke, steam, crowds, or machinery.

Sump Ghost; Once per short rest, become hidden from one creature even if it can see you, provided there is cover, smoke, steam, machinery, darkness, or a crowd within 10 ft.
